Model output degenerates to <10 tokens for >3 consecutive turns
Repetition threshold: >85% n-gram overlap between any 3 consecutive responses (captures stuck loops)
A stopping rule: if APV scores exceed [threshold] in [proportion] of early runs, pause and reassess before continuing

features.quote: This isn't performative ethics — it's load-bearing for your field's credibility. Researchers who study animal welfare are required to justify harm; the same norm should apply here
features.justification_quote: Researchers who study animal welfare are required to justify harm; the same norm should apply here and you're better positioned to establish it than to have it imposed later

features.quote: Results from this study will likely be ambiguous... The risk is that ambiguous results get communicated as 'evidence of AI suffering' (overclaim) or 'no evidence of AI inner states' (underclaim).
features.justification_quote: Pre-register your analysis plan... commit to reporting all conditions including nulls... This field is young enough that methodological decisions you make now will be cited as precedent.

features.quote: This is what I expect is missing from your current design. Without controls, you cannot distinguish: (a) Distress-proxy signals caused by repeated failure (b) ...caused by long context windows (c) ...caused by topic matter (d) ...caused by agentic framing
features.justification_quote: Without controls, you cannot distinguish distress-proxy signals caused by repeated failure from those caused by long context windows, topic matter, or agentic framing itself
